credits.title: Little Eggs: A Frozen Rescue
credits.overview: Toto and his family must travel to the South Pole to fulfill a promise: return a polar bear and some Spanish penguins to their home. To achieve this, they will have to overcome obstacles that teach them how important teamwork is.

credits.title: An Egg Rescue
credits.overview: Toto and his friends must rescue his egg children after they're taken away for a gourmet food event in Africa.

credits.title: No manches, Frida 2: paraíso destruido
credits.overview: Zequi and Lucy are about to get married. Although he promises not to overdo it during the bachelor party, things get out of control.

credits.title: No manches, Frida
credits.overview: After being released from prison, Zequi, a bank robber, sets out to recover money buried by his accomplice; but is horrified to learn that a high school gymnasium is now over the site where the loot is hidden.

credits.title: Perverse Game
credits.overview: Leo is a contestant in an illegal gameshow, broadcasted everywhere live. Stuck in an abandoned hotel with Karla, he'll have to try to escape by choosing what matters to him the most. Will love prevail? Or will greed?
